This MCP server provides comprehensive Google Workspace integration (Gmail, Drive, etc.) with multi-user OAuth.

Unique features include RAG-powered natural language to Chat card rendering, runtime Jinja2 macro creation, and dynamic tool management.

QDRANT_KEY.description: Qdrant API key (use NONE for no auth)

SSL_KEY_FILE.description: Path to SSL private key (Required if ENABLE_HTTPS is true)

MCP_TRANSPORT.description: Communication protocol (stdio or http). Glama's mcp-proxy expects stdio.

MINIMAL_TOOLS.description: Skip heavy module-wrapper indexing at startup (818-component email types, card_framework widgets). Set to 'true' for fast cold-start in environments with strict startup timeouts (Glama sandbox, CI smoke tests).

SSL_CERT_FILE.description: Path to SSL certificate (Required if ENABLE_HTTPS is true)

SAMPLING_TOOLS.description: Enable sampling middleware tools (validation agents). Requires VENICE_INFERENCE_KEY, LITELLM_API_KEY, or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

ENABLE_CODE_MODE.description: Enable Code Mode (sandboxed Python tool-call chaining via the `execute` meta-tool)

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID from Google Cloud Console

QDRANT_AUTO_LAUNCH.description: Automatically launch Qdrant via Docker if not reachable. Set to 'false' in single-container environments where Docker-in-Docker isn't available (Glama sandbox).

ATTACHMENT_TEMP_DIR.description: Temp directory for outbound attachment downloads (Gmail signed-URL serving)

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret from Google Cloud Console

DRIVE_UPLOAD_TEMP_DIR.description: Temp directory for staged client→server uploads (only used when DRIVE_UPLOAD_CLIENT_FS=true)

DRIVE_UPLOAD_CLIENT_FS.description: Treat upload_to_drive 'path' as the client's filesystem and orchestrate client→server→Drive transport via signed PUT URL. Set to 'true' on remote/hosted deployments where client and server are on different machines.

DRIVE_UPLOAD_MAX_SIZE_MB.description: Maximum size in MB for staged client→server uploads (only used when DRIVE_UPLOAD_CLIENT_FS=true)

DRIVE_UPLOAD_TTL_SECONDS.description: TTL in seconds for staged client→server upload URLs (one-time-use)

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRETS_FILE.description: Alternative: path to OAuth JSON file
